datasets.name: AI City Challenge 2021 · Track 4
datasets.purpose: Roadside traffic clips with crash and stalled-vehicle anomaly labels.
datasets.limitation: Reference labels mark incident onset; they do not establish reliable pre-impact prediction.

datasets.name: Nexar Collision Prediction
datasets.purpose: Collision and near-miss clips with event timing for studying warning lead time.
datasets.limitation: Dashcam viewpoint differs from fixed roadside CCTV; attribution, privacy, and redistribution restrictions apply.

datasets.name: BDD100K
datasets.purpose: General road-scene inputs for road-user and lane perception.
datasets.limitation: Not an accident-anticipation dataset; the full video collection is very large (1.8 TB).

datasets.name: Open road-scene demos
datasets.camera_view: Dashcam and elevated roadside; mixed views
datasets.purpose: Short, rights-reviewed real footage for local perception and workflow demonstrations.
datasets.limitation: Not a crash-prediction dataset or Rwanda/Kigali evaluation set. Event timing is unverified and privacy review is pending before external sharing.

clips.title: Rainy road approach - context footage
clips.permitted_uses: Local MVP playback and inference; privacy review before external sharing.
clips.annotation_reference: The uploader's description mentions encountering an accident during the trip. This 15.3-second excerpt has no verified collision label or event timestamp; use it only as road-scene footage.

clips.title: Berlin motorway - night traffic
clips.permitted_uses: Local MVP playback and inference; privacy review before external sharing.
clips.annotation_reference: 11.2-second elevated motorway view at night. No incident annotation is supplied; use it as road-scene footage only.
